name: hud_ui_layout_node_read_rect
description: HudUiLayoutNode::ReadRect reads a four-integer HUD rectangle from a ZRDR array node.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x413aa0 validates returning 0 for non-array nodes, reading the array payload into left, right, top, and bottom, and returning 1 on success.
The native smoke verifies successful array read ordering and that non-array input returns 0 without modifying the destination rectangle.
